criteria.text: Prompt “six mins to glob homie” produces zero automatically injected memories.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c1: “six mins to glob homie” injects zero memories

criteria.text: A Worship Committee agenda-editing prompt does not inject the McDonald’s report, AI-trend reports, daily summaries, or unrelated repo maps.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c2: a Worship Committee agenda prompt excludes reports, daily summaries, and repo maps

criteria.text: Prompt “resume?” produces no arbitrary nearest-neighbor documents.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c3: “resume?” is too underspecified to inject an arbitrary nearest document

criteria.text: A semantic backend returning path-only results without confidence fails closed for automatic injection.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c4: a semantic backend returning path-only hits fails closed

criteria.text: All candidates below the configured relevance threshold produce zero injection.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c5: candidates below the configured relevance threshold produce zero injection

criteria.text: A prompt explicitly asking which McDonald’s World Cup collector cups are rare retrieves the explicitly injectable report or a relevant excerpt.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c6: an explicitly injectable McDonald’s collector-cup report yields a relevant excerpt

criteria.text: A directly relevant stored preference is injected within the size budget.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c7: a directly relevant preference is injected within the documented budget

criteria.text: Explicit on-demand memory search can still find reports excluded from automatic injection.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c8: explicit on-demand repository search still finds an auto-excluded report

criteria.text: User A’s context never reaches user B.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c9: user A injection excludes user B even when a custom retrieval returns both

criteria.text: A null/unknown owner never retrieves user-owned context.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c10: null owner never injects user-owned context

criteria.text: Research reports, generated vault documents, daily summaries, transcripts, and long-form archives remain searchable but are excluded from automatic facts/preferences injection unless explicitly marked injectable.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c11: generated/long-form classes are excluded unless explicitly injectable

criteria.text: Total automatic context stays under the documented per-item and total character/token ceilings and prefers fewer results.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c12: automatic context prefers fewer excerpts and never exceeds 1200 chars / 300 estimated tokens

criteria.text: The default relevance threshold is derived from and separates a recorded positive/negative fixture corpus.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c13: the fixture corpus separates positives from negatives at threshold 0.60

criteria.text: Engraph ranking/confidence fields are preserved end to end without treating its RRF score as calibrated confidence.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c14: Engraph’s real score field is preserved but not mislabeled as confidence

criteria.text: Turn-level provenance records source, retrieval lane, score/confidence, and gate reason without logging note bodies.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c15: provenance records lane/score/reason without note content

criteria.text: Interactive WebSocket input resolves and uses the session’s real owner_user_id.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c16: interactive retrieval uses the session’s real owner_user_id

criteria.text: Interactive WebSocket input with a null/unknown owner never retrieves user-owned context.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c17: a null/unknown owner never retrieves user-owned context

criteria.text: Persisted/displayed user messages contain only original user text.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c18: persisted/displayed text and parts contain only the original user message

criteria.text: Reconnect, replay, transcript export, and session detail expose no hidden prefaces as user-authored text.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c19: reconnect/session-detail/replay inputs expose no hidden preface

criteria.text: Repeated turns cannot recursively amplify prior injected context.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c20: repeated turns cannot recursively amplify prior injected context

criteria.text: An env-gated live test seeds isolated fixtures, drives the real WebSocket/API path, verifies relevance, owner isolation, bounded context/provenance, and original-only persisted transcripts.
criteria.test_id: issue-0-c21: real prompt path enforces relevance, isolation, provenance, and persistence
